thread:
Elaine (design): Quick run-through from my pairing session — found a few UX edges around structured output + tool-calls. Posting everything here so it's tracked.
Tariq (devex): Thanks! Short list please, then we can prioritize.
Elaine (design): 1) Run history rows feel heavy when function outputs are JSON; we should collapse to a summary line (key:value snippets) unless expanded. 2) The copy icon is tiny and tooltip just says 'Copy' 12 unclear for structured outputs. 3) Mixing 'Run' and 'Invoke' in toolbars is confusing.
Jia (eng): Re: focus: when toggling expand we re-render the item list which causes focus to jump to the top. I can try to diff and avoid unmounting nodes.
Sam (accessibility): Add `aria-label="Copy output as JSON"` and make the expand toggle `aria-expanded` with `aria-controls`. Also ensure the summary uses semantic markup (dl/dd) for key/value pairs so screen readers can navigate.
Elaine (design): Mock idea: compact row shows up to 3 key:value chips (truncate values), trailing ellipsis if more. Clicking chip or `Show structured output` opens a right-hand flyout with full JSON + metadata (model, version, prompt).
Tariq (devex): Can we also surface a small badge when output used tool-calling so it's clear which run used functions vs. plain text?
Jia (eng): Yeah a tiny "tool" badge is easy. Also proposing dev-pref `default_output_view: compact|raw`. New users get compact. Add feature flag for rollback.
devex-bot: PR created by jia: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/431 (WIP)
Sam (accessibility): Also keyboard: ensure `Enter` or `E` toggles expansion when focused on a run row. When expanded, focus should move into the flyout and announce "Run details for [timestamp] expanded" via aria-live.
Elaine (design): Copy wording: prefer "Show structured output" over "Expand JSON" to avoid jargon. And copy button tooltip: "Copy output as JSON".
Tariq (devex): Agree. Also keep 'Run' in top-level CTA, replace stray 'Invoke' occurrences in the history toolbar. Elaine can submit copy diffs.
Elaine (design): I'll push the copy diff and a 2-up mock in Figma: https://figma.com/file/aaa111/playground-compact-vs-raw (comments attached).
Jia (eng): Plan: 1) compact renderer for objects with <=6 keys, 2) stable keys for list items to avoid reordering DOM, 3) aria labels + keyboard shortcuts. Will include unit tests for focus restore. ETA: tomorrow AM.
Tariq (devex): Can we track metrics: expand rate, copy button clicks, toggles per user? We'll add telemetry keys.
Sam (accessibility): I'll review PR for SR/keyboard behavior. Quick note: for truncated values include `title` attribute with full content for hover.
Elaine (design): One more tiny UI nit: divider between run rows is visually heavy; lighten it to 1px #E6 and increase whitespace to improve scan.
Tariq (devex): Noted. Assign owners: Jia (impl), Sam (a11y review), Elaine (copy + mocks). I'll link the PR to the devex board.
Elaine (design): Thanks all 14 will follow up with the copy patch.
Jia (eng): PR up in ~3 hours.
Tariq (devex): Great work 14 we'll check results next week.
